title: CamelEval: Advancing Culturally Aligned Arabic Language Models and Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating culturally aligned responses using the CamelEval Curated Set—which contains prompts reflecting Arabic cultural nuances, history, and religion—assessed via an LLM-as-a-judge framework. Additionally measured using the zero-shot ACVA (Arabic Cultural Value Alignment) multiple-choice benchmark.

Assessing the model's ability to produce natural, human-like Arabic and avoid 'translationese' (translation artifacts from Western-centric data) by comparing performance on natively curated Arabic prompts versus translated English prompts in the CamelEval benchmark.
